answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 65 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 15 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 65 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 140 sponsors, each risking real money. The atlas of the design is public, the wharf of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the summit of honest work is what finally pays.
